title: Machine Learning Engineer II
description:
We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to build and ship ML systems end to end. You will work with product teams to turn business questions into models.
Day to day you will write production code in Python Fundamentals, train and validate models with scikit-learn and precision recall, and ship them with containerization and model serving. Working knowledge of Deep Learning Concepts and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is expected.
We value clean Git & GitHub history, aws experience, and a solid grip on Linear Algebra and inference.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are hiring a Data Analyst to turn raw data into decisions. You will own analyses from data extraction to the final slide.
You will query warehouses with basic sql and Advanced SQL, clean and shape data in Python for Data (NumPy/Pandas), and build dashboards in Dashboard Tools. Hypothesis tests and ab testing design are part of the role.
Strong plotting and dashboards for executives skills are essential; you will present findings to non-technical stakeholders weekly.

title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
We are hiring a Software Engineer (Backend) to design and maintain the services behind our platform. You will own features from API contract to deployment.
You will build REST API Design APIs on Web Frameworks, model data in SQL Basics, and harden them with Auth & Security and redis. docker compose and azure are used for every deployment.
We expect integration tests practice, clean Git & GitHub workflows, and comfort scaling services with rabbitmq.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
We are hiring a Frontend Developer to craft fast, accessible interfaces. You will partner with designers and API teams to ship features.
You will build components with Modern Frontend Frameworks and TypeScript, style with CSS Frameworks, and wire them to APIs using API Integration in the Browser. Async UI, especially api consumption, is core to this role.
We care about cypress, vite, and lazy loading; delightful and fast wins.
